placements.name: Reefton
placements.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Reefton (town centre; a town, not an attraction)
placements.reason: Hub town on SH7 with its own Wikivoyage chapter (Black's Point Museum, Broadway heritage street, Powerhouse); 40+ km from every existing destination. Proposed for the owner: needs description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months and a header before it is added.
placements.bio: A historic gold town on State Highway 7 with a heritage Broadway, Black's Point Museum and the Powerhouse.
placements.coordinates_verify: Town centre point; header needs a curated photo (the accepted photo is for the card only).

placements.name: Waiuta
placements.reason: 19 km from Reefton; DOC ghost town (Prohibition mine, ball mill).
placements.bio: A gold-mining ghost town with the Prohibition mine, a ball mill and the boiler-house ruins (the Snowy Battery Track is closed because of contamination).
placements.coordinates_verify: Town-site point; confirm car park with DOC.

placements.name: Brunner Mine Historic Area
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Greymouth listing (-42.4336,171.3246), agrees with Commons photo coordinates of the site (-42.4337,171.3246)
placements.reason: 10 km from Greymouth (inside its span); a DOC historic site visitors reach from Greymouth. Wikivoyage Greymouth + DOC.
placements.bio: The ruins of the Brunner coal mine, where you cross a suspension bridge to coke ovens and mine remains on the Grey River gorge.

placements.name: West Coast Wilderness Trail
placements.coordinates_source: Wikipedia West Coast Wilderness Trail: Greymouth start
placements.reason: Long linear feature placed at its main access (Greymouth start, inside Greymouth's span, where riders base); runs on to Ross.
placements.bio: A 132 km Great Ride cycle trail from Greymouth to Ross through old gold-rush country.
placements.coordinates_verify: Pin is the Greymouth start from Wikipedia; confirm the trailhead (DOC/trail operator) before applying.

placements.name: Croesus Track
placements.coordinates_source: Needs the Smoke-ho car park at Blackball from DOC/OSM; the OSM figure is a mean of two segments (approximate)
placements.reason: Trailhead near Blackball is 19 km from Greymouth (inside its span), reached from Greymouth; the Barrytown end is on the Paparoa coast but visitors start from Blackball.
placements.bio: A 22 km miners' track over the Paparoa Range from Blackball to Barrytown, walked in one or two days.
placements.photo_note: No scenic Commons or Openverse photo of the track itself (hut close-ups, ferns, one 2007 hut shot). Hold for a photo.

placements.name: Carters Beach
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing point (-41.744,171.562) is a district point; needs OSM natural/beach or its Wikipedia article
placements.reason: 3 km from Westport, a town beach reached from Westport.
placements.bio: A wide sand beach beside Westport for walking, swimming and surfing.
placements.photo_note: Best Commons file (low-tide shot, 4032x3024, CC BY-SA) shows the beach as a thin strip at the horizon; the hero crop is mostly blue water and fails recognisability. Needs another photo.

placements.name: Gillespies Beach
placements.reason: 22 km from the park centre, reached from Fox Glacier by an 11 km unsealed road.
placements.bio: A black-sand and quartz-pebble beach at the end of an unsealed road, with gold-dredge ruins, a seal colony and views to Aoraki / Mount Cook and Mount Tasman.

photo.file: 009 NZ Southern Alps mountain landscape in New Zealand seen from Gillespies Beach, West Coast - sunset light.jpg

placements.coordinates_verify: Wikivoyage listing point; confirm against OSM natural/beach or its own Wikipedia article. Not the Gillespie Beach near Cape Foulwind.

placements.name: Roberts Point Track
placements.reason: 8 km from Franz Josef; distinct from the valley walk (5 h 20 return tramp).
placements.bio: A 5 h 20 return tramp with swing bridges to a viewpoint over Franz Josef Glacier.
placements.coordinates_verify: Wikivoyage listing; confirm trailhead (car park) with DOC/OSM.

placements.name: Copland Track
placements.coordinates_source: The Wikivoyage point (-43.5749,169.81) is Welcome Flat, not the trailhead; needs the Copland shelter on SH6 from DOC/OSM
placements.reason: 25 km from the park centre, reached from Fox Glacier (Hump Ridge precedent for a promoted multi-day walk). Welcome Flat Hot Pools stays folded in.
placements.bio: A 6 to 8 hour tramp one way up the Copland valley to the Welcome Flat hot pools, with the Alps ahead.

placements.name: Tatare Tunnels Walk
placements.reason: At Franz Josef; 80-minute walk to old water tunnels. Kept; held for a photo.
placements.bio: An 80-minute walk from Cowan Street to old water tunnels built for gold mining.
placements.photo_note: Only Commons file is a close-up of a stony path, no tunnels; no other free photo found. Hold for a photo.
placements.coordinates_verify: Cowan Street is the street; confirm car park with DOC/OSM.

placements.name: Whataroa White Heron Colony
placements.coordinates_source: Reserve on the Waitangiroto River has no coordinate found; the Wikivoyage tour office (-43.2618,170.3614) is Whataroa village, not the reserve
placements.reason: 25 km from the park centre; reached by guided tour from Whataroa. The place is the spot, the tour is how you reach it.
placements.bio: The only New Zealand breeding site of the white heron (kōtuku), reached on a guided tour from Whataroa between late October and the end of February.
placements.photo_note: Photo not searched in this pass; find one of the colony or river.

placements.name: Oparara Arch
placements.coordinates_source: Commons photo coordinates -41.1463,172.1871 (the arch); DOC Oparara car park via McCallums Mill Road ~23 km from Karamea
placements.reason: 14 km from the park centre; Oparara Basin lies in Kahurangi National Park (a spot of the park). Overlaps existing kahurangi-2 Ōpārara Basin: owner to decide whether to merge.
placements.bio: A 35-million-year-old limestone arch about 200 m long, reached on a one-hour return walk.
placements.coordinates_verify: Photo coordinates; check against DOC car park.

placements.name: Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn Loop
placements.coordinates_source: Same Oparara car park as the arch (DOC); NOT the arch itself, needs its own point from DOC/OSM
placements.reason: Same basin as Oparara Arch; skeptic kept both and suggests the owner may merge into one Oparara Basin spot (existing kahurangi-2).
placements.bio: A 4 km, 1 h 30 loop through old-growth forest to Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn.
placements.coordinates_verify: Reuses the Oparara Arch point as a placeholder; take the Moria Gate trailhead from DOC/OSM.

placements.name: Scotts Beach
placements.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Scotts Beach (own article); trailhead is Kohaihai
placements.reason: 17 km from the park centre; in Kahurangi National Park, a 1-hour walk from Kohaihai at the first stretch of the Heaphy Track, reached from Karamea.
placements.bio: A beach on the Heaphy Track coast reached by a one-hour walk from Kohaihai.

photo.file: Scotts Beach from Kohaihai Bluff (Kahurangi National Park).jpg

placements.coordinates_verify: Beach point from Wikipedia; trailhead (Kohaihai car park) from DOC/OSM.

placements.name: Old Ghost Road
placements.coordinates_source: DOC: Lyell Campsite is the trail start; Wikipedia Lyell -41.7969,172.0483. Mokihinui end ~-41.5517,171.99
placements.reason: Lyell is 37 km from Westport (outside its 26 km reach) and 68+ km from every other destination; sold by Westport outfitters but a trip of its own (Hump Ridge precedent).
placements.bio: An 85 km Great Ride and tramping route from Lyell to the Mokihinui, 4 to 5 days on foot or 2 to 3 by bike.
placements.coordinates_verify: Village point from Wikipedia; confirm Lyell trailhead with DOC.

placements.name: Lake Brunner
placements.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Moana (visitor point on the lake; not the lake centroid at -42.6167,171.45)
placements.reason: 26 km from Greymouth (outside its 22.5 km reach), TranzAlpine stops at Moana; a lake with its own walks.
placements.bio: A lake with walks of 20 minutes to 8 hours around Moana, where the TranzAlpine stops.
placements.coordinates_verify: Moana village point; confirm a lakeshore access point.

placements.name: Charming Creek Walkway
placements.coordinates_source: DOC lists a car park at the mine site; the Ngakawau south end (-41.6064,171.8806) is 28 km from Westport; OSM mean (-41.6042,171.9112) is approximate. Needs the car park from DOC/OSM
placements.reason: 28 to 31 km from Westport (outside its 26 km reach), so standalone.
placements.bio: A former mine railway walk of 5.5 km one way (2 h) to Mangatini Falls through tunnels and past mine relics; split into north and south walkways by a slip.

placements.name: Monro Beach
placements.coordinates_source: Commons photo coordinates -43.6959,169.2653 (the beach); DOC: car park 35 km north of Haast on SH6
placements.reason: 76 km from Westland Tai Poutini's centre, outside every span; reached from Haast.
placements.bio: A beach with sea stacks reached by a 4.7 km, 1 h 20 return track, where Fiordland crested penguins (tawaki) nest from September to November.

photo.file: Monro Beach, West Coast Region, New Zealand 06.jpg

placements.coordinates_verify: Beach point from a photo; take the SH6 car park from DOC/OSM, and check OSM natural/beach.

placements.name: Ship Creek Walks
placements.reason: 87 km from Westland's centre, outside every span; reached from Haast.
placements.bio: Short walks of about 20 minutes through kahikatea swamp forest and past a dune lake to a beach lookout.

photo.file: TWC Ship Creek• Stewart Nimmo • MRD 9976.jpg

placements.coordinates_verify: Article point; confirm car park with DOC/OSM.

existing_fixes.name: Karamea
existing_fixes.issue: Skeptic sent the gateway village Karamea to review (small museum open summer afternoons; its draws are Oparara and Heaphy). It already exists as kahurangi-3: re-judge, and either keep as a low-rank spot or remove.

existing_fixes.name: Ōpārara Basin
existing_fixes.issue: Near-duplicate risk with new Oparara Arch (kahurangi-4) and Moria Gate Arch and Mirror Tarn Loop (kahurangi-5): either keep the basin as one spot and drop the two new ones, or keep the two and retire the basin (the basin's id stays if retained).

existing_fixes.name: Lewis Pass
existing_fixes.issue: Listed by DOC under both West Coast and Canterbury; one standalone entry exists (Canterbury region in scripts/coverage-regions.json). Do not duplicate.

existing_fixes.name: Heaphy Track
existing_fixes.issue: Kept; West Coast end is at Karamea but the spot belongs to Kahurangi. No change.

existing_fixes.name: West Coast Wildlife Centre
existing_fixes.issue: Kept, no change. The Tatare Tunnels candidate row pointed to this id by mistake; Tatare Tunnels is a new spot (westland-tai-poutini-10).

new_destinations.name: Reefton
new_destinations.reason: A sizeable settlement with its own Wikivoyage chapter and a heritage street, 40+ km from the nearest destination; Waiuta lies 19 km away. Victoria Forest Park (review) and Big River/Reefton walks fold in. Listed for the owner, not added.
new_destinations.needs: description, three reasons with photos, tips, best months, header (WRITING.md)

review_not_placed.name: Blackball
review_not_placed.skeptic: For: Wikivoyage? no page (404); Wikipedia and DOC Croesus page name the village as trailhead; Museum of Working Class History, Blackball Hilton. Against: no counted visitor source for the village itself; gateway whose draw is Croesus Track. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Charleston
review_not_placed.skeptic: Wikivoyage Charleston (NZ) page exists (checked, it was empty in the recall). For: Constant Bay and Joyce Bay lookouts, Underworld glow-worm cave rafting, Mitchells Gully goldmine. Against: mostly operators and 15-minute loops; Constant Bay Loop was rejected. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Lyell
review_not_placed.skeptic: DOC Lyell area page: campsite, gold-mining walks, fossicking; also the Old Ghost Road start. Against: remote ghost settlement, part of the Old Ghost Road. Review.
review_not_placed.note: Start of the Old Ghost Road (old-ghost-road, standalone)

review_not_placed.name: Jackson Bay
review_not_placed.skeptic: DOC page opened: road end 51 km south of Haast, short walks, wharf, Craypot cafe (Wikivoyage Haast). For: end-of-the-road stop. Against: remote, coordinates missing (use Wikipedia/OSM), draw is the drive. Gateway-journey case, review.

review_not_placed.name: Wangapeka Track
review_not_placed.skeptic: DOC, Wikipedia and Wikivoyage Karamea name it (two counted sources). For: a 59 km multi-day tramp from the Karamea end. Against: mostly in the Tasman region, not a Great Walk, few visitors. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Haast
review_not_placed.skeptic: For: Wikivoyage chapter, DOC Awarua/Haast Visitor Centre, jetboat safaris, last settlement before the pass. Against: its See section is generic; the draws (Ship Creek, Monro Beach, Jackson Bay) are separate spots. A gateway whose draw is the journey beyond: review (Pipiriki benchmark).
review_not_placed.note: If kept, a Haast destination would hold Monro Beach (monro-beach), Ship Creek (ship-creek) and Jackson Bay; those two stay standalone meanwhile.

review_not_placed.name: Karamea
review_not_placed.skeptic: For: Wikivoyage chapter, end-of-road village, base for Oparara, Heaphy, caves. Against: the village has only a small museum open summer afternoons; Oparara/Heaphy are spots. Gateway village, review.

review_not_placed.name: Ross
review_not_placed.skeptic: For: Wikivoyage chapter, historic goldfield, gold panning. Against: the Wikivoyage page is an outline with only gold panning, one source; the recall note's heritage centre and walks are not on it. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Murchison
review_not_placed.skeptic: For: Wikivoyage chapter, Buller Gorge rafting base, tiny museum. Against: See section is one tiny museum; Wikivoyage does not give it a real stop. Also overlaps the Tasman region (Murchison is a Tasman-side destination candidate): decide once. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Victoria Forest Park
review_not_placed.skeptic: Downgraded from keep. For: DOC park page, 206,000 ha, mining relics. Against: a park with no single visitor point or named stop; Waiuta, Big River mine and Reefton walks are the actual stops and are judged separately. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Tauranga Bay Fur Seal Colony
review_not_placed.skeptic: Downgraded from keep. For: Wikivoyage + DOC name it, 10-minute wheelchair track, a real wildlife stop. Against: existing Cape Foulwind spot's bio already ends at this colony, so it is a near-duplicate / part of a larger spot. Review (merge into Cape Foulwind if not kept).
review_not_placed.note: Merge into westport-1 Cape Foulwind if not kept

review_not_placed.name: Chalet Lookout Walk
review_not_placed.skeptic: Downgraded from keep. For: Wikivoyage Fox Glacier lists a 1h15 viewpoint over the glacier. Against: one source and the same glacier as the existing Fox Glacier spot; Moraine and Swing Bridge walks start at the same car park. Review.

review_not_placed.name: Honeycomb Hill Cave
review_not_placed.skeptic: Downgraded from keep. For: newzealand.com and Wikivoyage Karamea list guided cave tours with moa bone sites. Against: guided-only operator experience, no usable free photo found (a 1960s B&W silhouette and moa skeletons only). Review.

notes: All entries are drafts for Pipeline C research: hours, cost, ticketUrl and visit hours are null (no source gave them). Coordinates null where a trailhead must come from DOC/OSM; provisional_coordinates shows the nearest source point (not applied).
